meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 接入 WhatsApp 频道:从 channels 分支拷入原生 Baileys 适配器并注册,安装指定版本依赖、构建、跑注册测试;再用二维码或配对码完成链接设备。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道时触发;开始前必须做号码安全检查,确认用专用号还是共用号,选共用号会先给出封号风险警告。

say.text: 帮我加上 WhatsApp 频道
say.note: 先做号码安全检查,再拷入并注册适配器

say.text: 我用专用号码,走二维码链接
say.note: 终端显示二维码,用手机扫码
输入手机号,手机端录入 8 位码

howto.what_en: Adds WhatsApp through the native Baileys adapter — a direct WhatsApp Web link, no Chat SDK bridge. It copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs pinned deps, builds, then links via QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. A number safety check runs first, asking whether to use a dedicated or shared number; picking shared shows an account-risk warning.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp channel for me
say_en.note: Runs the number safety check first

say_en.text: Use a dedicated number, link by QR
say_en.note: A QR appears in the terminal to scan

say_en.text: Link with a pairing code instead
say_en.note: Enter your phone number, get an 8-character code
